field_basis.price_tick: RULE-DERIVED, NON-SCALAR — no single tick value is printed for BTC. tick-and-lot-size-api.html: "Prices can have up to 5 significant figures, but no more than MAX_DECIMALS - szDecimals decimal places where MAX_DECIMALS is 6 for perps and 8 for spot. Integer prices are always allowed, regardless of the number of significant figures." BTC szDecimals=5, perp MAX_DECIMALS=6 => non-integer prices may have at most 6-5=1 decimal place and at most 5 significant figures. Positive integers, including 100001, remain valid regardless of digit count; there is no mandatory 10-unit step above 100000. Because the venue defines price validity by a rule (significant figures + decimal bound + integers-always-allowed) rather than a published per-asset scalar, price_tick remains null and the approved price_alignment_policy carries the actual rule.
field_basis.quantity_step: DERIVED — rule quoted, derivation shown. tick-and-lot-size-api.html: "Sizes are rounded to the szDecimals of that asset. For example, if szDecimals = 3 then 1.001 is a valid size but 1.0001 is not." BTC szDecimals=5 (frozen api-info-meta.json). A size is valid iff it has at most szDecimals decimal places, so the smallest positive increment between two valid sizes is 10^-szDecimals = 10^-5 = 0.00001 BTC.
